# /crav1-ado-to-tasks

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From Azure Boards to tasks](../../from-ado-to-tasks.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-ado-to-tasks/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read back the Azure Boards task items a spec records and bring kept changes into the spec and tasks.md.

Pick a spec with task lines in `work-item.md`, or all. Every recorded task item is read back (State, title, description, acceptance, Assigned To, comments, history) and only what differs from the spec and `tasks.md` is shown, plus child items under the Feature that no task line records.

Each difference is kept or dismissed, fresh every run. Kept changes go in through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). A task in the done state in Azure Boards ticks its box only on your yes; one reopened there unticks a ticked box only on your yes. A new child is added as a task, with its id recorded in `work-item.md`, only on your yes. It never writes a field back; a reply comment is stripped and posted only on yes.

## Runs when

Bring changes on a spec's task items in Azure Boards back into the spec. Called by the user. [`/crav1-tasks-to-ado`](crav1-tasks-to-ado.md) names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: The task items a spec records, and the Feature's children.

Reads the org and project the same way as [`/crav1-specs-to-ado`](crav1-specs-to-ado.md), the task lines and the Feature line in `work-item.md`, every recorded task item with its comments and history, the child type's fields, and the Feature's children.

## Writes

In short: Kept changes through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md); a comment in Azure Boards after a yes.

Writes the spec and `tasks.md` only through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for kept changes, ticks a box or adds a task only after a yes, appends a task line to `work-item.md` for an added task, and posts a reply comment only after a yes.

## Does not

Leaves every Azure Boards field, `tasks.md` ids, and dismissed changes alone.

Limits and exceptions: a spec with no task lines names [`/crav1-tasks-to-ado`](crav1-tasks-to-ado.md). A missing id is reported as missing, not guessed. Dismiss is for this run only. It does not commit. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for each kept change.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Azure Boards. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).
